================================================================================
Type tokens, @selector and a block literal inside a macro argument list
================================================================================

void f(void) {
    ExtendImplementationOfNonVoidMethodWithoutArguments([UIBarItem class], @selector(init), __kindof UIBarItem *, ^__kindof UIBarItem *(UIBarItem *selfObject, __kindof UIBarItem *originReturnValue) {
        [selfObject qmui_didInitialize];
        return originReturnValue;
    });
}

(translation_unit

    (primitive_type)

      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))
    (compound_statement
      (macro_declaration
        (identifier)
        (macro_argument_list
          (identifier)
          (identifier)
          (macro_argument_list
            (identifier))
          (identifier)
          (block_literal
            (type_name
              (type_qualifier)
              (type_identifier)
              (abstract_pointer_declarator
                (abstract_function_declarator
                  (parameter_list
                    (parameter_declaration
                      (type_identifier)
                      (pointer_declarator
                        (identifier)))
                    (parameter_declaration
                      (type_qualifier)
                      (type_identifier)
                      (pointer_declarator
                        (identifier)))))))
            (compound_statement
              (expression_statement
                (message_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (identifier)))
